PromptFiles: REQUIRED: path to a prompts .txt file (one prompt per line). Portable across machines: use a path relative to the repo root (e.g. "2023-prompts.txt"), a leading ~ for home, or %VAR% env vars. You can list more than one file.
Example second file — or remove this array entry.
IdeogramApiKey: Optional: Ideogram API key from https://ideogram.ai/manage-api (paid). Required for Ideogram v2/v2a/v3 generators.
OpenAIApiKey: Optional: OpenAI key from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys (paid). Required for DALL-E 3 and GPT Image 1 / GPT Image 1 Mini generators.
BFLApiKey: Optional: Black Forest Labs (Flux) key from https://api.bfl.ai/ (paid). Required for BFL v1.1 and BFL v1.1 Ultra generators.
KreaApiKey: Optional: Krea API token from https://www.krea.ai/app/api/tokens (paid). Required for Krea 2 Turbo, Medium, and Large.
AnthropicApiKey: Optional: Anthropic key from https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys (paid). Required for Claude-based prompt rewriting steps.
RecraftApiKey: Optional: Recraft API key from https://www.recraft.ai/ (paid). Required for Recraft generators.
XAIGrokApiKey: Optional: xAI API key from https://console.x.ai/. Required for Grok Imagine image/video generators.
GrokWebCookiePath: Optional: absolute path to grok.com browser cookies (Netscape cookies.txt or raw Cookie header). Required for --grok-web.
GrokWebBrowserExecutablePath: Optional: Chrome/Chromium binary for grok-web video generation. Leave blank to use Playwright's Chromium (install once with --playwright-install).
MetaWebCookiePath: Optional: absolute path to meta.ai browser cookies (Netscape cookies.txt or raw Cookie header; needs datr + ecto_1_sess, ideally the full jar). Alternative to logging in once with --meta-web --meta-web-headed.
MetaWebBrowserProfilePath: Optional: persistent Chromium profile dir for --meta-web. Leave blank for ~/.config/multi-image-client/meta-ai-profile. Log in once with --meta-web-headed; the profile keeps the session.
MetaWebBrowserExecutablePath: Optional: path to an existing Chrome/Chromium binary for --meta-web. Leave blank to use Playwright's own Chromium (install once with --playwright-install).
XAIBaseUrl: Optional: xAI API base URL. Leave blank for https://api.x.ai/v1, or set a regional host such as https://us-east-1.api.x.ai/v1 if your account has access.
GoogleGeminiApiKey: Optional: Google Gemini (AI Studio) key from https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/api-key. Used by the Gemini image (NanoBanana) generator. Imagen transport selection must be configured explicitly rather than changed after failure.
GoogleCloudApiKey: Optional: Google Cloud / Vertex AI API key (alternative to service-account auth).
GoogleCloudLocation: REQUIRED for Imagen 4: Google Cloud region, e.g. us-central1. See https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/general/locations
GoogleCloudProjectId: REQUIRED for Imagen 4: Google Cloud project id from https://console.cloud.google.com/
GoogleServiceAccountKeyPath: REQUIRED for Imagen 4: absolute path to a service-account JSON key file (IAM & Admin > Service Accounts > Keys).
GenerationArchiveDbPath: Optional: local SQLite audit database path. Leave blank to use ImageDownloadBaseFolder/generation-history.sqlite3.
ComfyUIBaseUrl: Optional: local ComfyUI server URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8188. Required for Local ComfyUI providers.
ComfyUIWorkflowPath: Optional: absolute path to an API-format ComfyUI workflow JSON. Put {{PROMPT}} in the positive prompt field. Optional model placeholders: {{UNET}}, {{CHECKPOINT}}, {{VAE}}, {{TEXT_ENCODER}}, {{TEXT_ENCODER2}}, {{LORA}}, {{LORA_STRENGTH_MODEL}}, {{LORA_STRENGTH_CLIP}}.
ComfyUIWorkflowName: Optional: short filename/metadata label for this local workflow, e.g. flux2-klein-custom.
ComfyUIDiffusionModelName: Optional: ComfyUI diffusion_models filename to substitute for {{UNET}} / {{DIFFUSION_MODEL}}.
ComfyUICheckpointName: Optional: ComfyUI checkpoints filename to substitute for {{CHECKPOINT}} / {{CKPT}}.
ComfyUIVaeName: Optional: ComfyUI vae filename to substitute for {{VAE}}.
ComfyUITextEncoderName: Optional: primary ComfyUI text_encoders filename to substitute for {{TEXT_ENCODER}} / {{CLIP}}.
ComfyUITextEncoder2Name: Optional: secondary ComfyUI text_encoders filename to substitute for {{TEXT_ENCODER2}} / {{CLIP2}}.
ComfyUILoraName: Optional: ComfyUI loras filename to substitute for {{LORA}}.
ComfyUIFlux2KleinWorkflowPath: Legacy optional path, still supported. Prefer ComfyUIWorkflowPath.
ComfyUIZImageWorkflowPath: Optional: absolute path to an API-format ComfyUI workflow JSON for Z-Image or Z-Image-Turbo. Put {{PROMPT}} in the positive prompt field. Uses the same optional placeholders as ComfyUIWorkflowPath.
ComfyUIZImageWorkflowName: Optional: short filename/metadata label for this local Z-Image workflow, e.g. z-image-turbo.
ComfyUIZImageDiffusionModelName: Optional: Z-Image ComfyUI diffusion_models filename to substitute for {{UNET}} / {{DIFFUSION_MODEL}}.
ComfyUIZImageCheckpointName: Optional: Z-Image ComfyUI checkpoints filename to substitute for {{CHECKPOINT}} / {{CKPT}}.
ComfyUIZImageVaeName: Optional: Z-Image ComfyUI vae filename to substitute for {{VAE}}.
ComfyUIZImageTextEncoderName: Optional: Z-Image primary ComfyUI text_encoders filename to substitute for {{TEXT_ENCODER}} / {{CLIP}}.
ComfyUIZImageTextEncoder2Name: Optional: Z-Image secondary ComfyUI text_encoders filename to substitute for {{TEXT_ENCODER2}} / {{CLIP2}}.
ComfyUIZImageLoraName: Optional: Z-Image ComfyUI loras filename to substitute for {{LORA}}.
